description: This file defines a class 'Operations' implementing various mathematical functions such as modulus, power, product, and quotient within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for handling array inputs and error management.

classes.name: Operations
classes.description: Contains static methods implementing various mathematical functions such as MOD, POWER, PRODUCT, and QUOTIENT, supporting array inputs and error handling.

methods.name: mod
methods.description: Calculates the modulus (remainder) of dividend divided by divisor, supporting array inputs and sign adjustment.

methods.name: power
methods.description: Calculates base raised to an exponent, with error handling for invalid inputs and support for array inputs.

methods.name: product
methods.description: Returns the product of all provided numerical arguments, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: quotient
methods.description: Returns the integer quotient of numerator divided by denominator, with validation and support for array inputs.
